logp.method_description: The lipophilicity (log Po/w) of the complexes was determined in n-octanol (o) and water (w) by the classical flask-shaking method.2-4 For this, 0.5 mg of complexes was taken in 3 mL of a 1:1 v/v mixture of n-octanol and water mixture and mixed vigorously for 24 h. Subsequently, the mixture was kept at a stationary state for an additional 24 h to reach saturation. Then the n-octanol and water phases were separated. Next, the concentration of complexes in both the n-octanol (Co) and water (Cw)phases was determined by UV-vis spectroscopy to calculate log Po/w = log [C]o/[C]w values.
